definitions.win_rate: share of valid days with value > 0
definitions.hac: Bartlett Newey-West, bandwidth max(H-1, floor(4*(n/100)^(2/9))); >=60 and >=10*(bandwidth+1) dates; complete finite grid after trimming edge gaps; asymptotic normal; no multiple-testing adjustment
definitions.monthly: descriptive only; no monthly HAC or significance
definitions.mean_stocks: mean over valid days of stocks with both a factor value and a matured label
definitions.groups: G0 = highest factor; 5 equal-count groups per signal date; equal-weight H-day open-to-open gross forward return; overlapping labels; not tradable returns
definitions.spread: daily G0 - G4, theoretical gross difference, not a long-short strategy return
definitions.monotonicity: daily -Spearman(group index, group return), averaged; monotonicity_of_means uses the period means
definitions.test: rolling exposed Test rows from the controlled evaluator receipt; unmatured signal dates are N/A, never 0
